acceptance_criteria: All 11,331 deduplicated condition/seed jobs complete or resume under matching config, implementation, checkpoint, chunk, and output hashes.

The N=100, dt=0.01, printed preparation, all printed p0/activity series, diagnostic shear rates, and reconstructed logarithmic shear grid produce all 17 numerical panels without raw/reference/author-code inputs.
Finite-difference forces, energy descent, trivalence, torus Euler topology, Lees--Edwards remapping, checkpoint identity, and three-seed aggregation remain valid throughout the campaign.
Yield/Newtonian/CST/DST classifications, VFT fits, tension-network diagnostics, and Peclet collapse pass the target-specific scientific and falsification checks.
Unprinted random states, exact averaging windows, shear grid, and T1 reset length remain reconstructed provenance and prevent paper-exact promotion even after execution.
Reduced-scale auxiliary targets T018-T024 are generated from independent numerics and frozen to CSV plus figure artifacts.
The runner reads only case-local code and config; no paper-source figure or author numerical array is a scientific input.
These artifacts remain exploratory until a paper-scale isolated run binds the caption/text parameter contract.
Reduced-scale claim-specific targets T029-T030 are generated from independent numerics and frozen to CSV plus figure artifacts.
The runner records explicit zero-shear Green-Kubo conditions and an extended p0 scan through 4.03 without reading paper-source figure pixels.
These artifacts remain exploratory until a paper-scale isolated run binds the paper's claim-level acceptance evidence.
The factor and sign candidates are checked against an independent finite-difference energy derivative and explicit energy descent.
The frozen three-seed attempt compares printed dt=0.01 with dt=0.005/0.0025 and compares N=64/100/144 under predeclared tolerances.
T025-T026 pass their analytic scientific checks; T027-T028 honestly retain failed convergence verdicts and require longer steady-state compute rather than post-hoc tolerance changes.
